translations.web: Let still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
translations.bsb: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
translations.kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
translations.asv: And be it still my consolation, Yea, let me exult in pain that spareth not, That I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
